node.title: Engineering World Model — the unified graph
node.summary: A single source of truth connecting teams, tools, repos, and workflows — the graph that makes cross-stage attribution possible.
node.interview_question: You call it a 'world model' — how is that different from a service catalog or an internal developer portal?

competitor.name: Cortex
competitor.positioning: Cortex (and Port/Backstage) already claim to be the system-of-record graph of services and ownership; they argue the catalog they own is the real source of truth.
